lanes.statement: The one frozen case reached its terminal assertion by pressing the sign-in form's controls from the Setup deep link: the owner's Setup route rendered the one seeded generic-agent installation by its display name, with revision r2 open; the compact walk reached the same heading.

Carried from the control-centre audit at this same commit: presentation fails on three claims the Grammar family stamps and renders differently on its own nodes (routed to the family owner), six topics are blocked for want of a claim, and the taste lens is fix-first on composition this delivery did not touch. Nothing this walk saw contradicts it.

Mean 3.73 over the eleven criteria: UX-9 fails because the Setup step's primary action sits below the fold at 390x844, two criteria are unobserved by this bounded run and carry the neutral midpoint, and the task, the step budget, the wayfinding and the resumed deep link score high.

entries.measured: the run reached the flow's terminal assertion for its one frozen case: the owner's Setup route rendered heading "Dedicated Setup QA generic agent", the display name of the one seeded generic-agent installation, 1194ms after the first navigation against a 90s budget; every step was a visible label (Email, Mật khẩu, Đăng nhập, the heading, the Thiết lập tab) and the entry was the flow's own deep link; the declared compact alternate path at 390x844 reached the same heading in the second walk

one submission (the sign-in form: two fields and one press) against the flow's budget of 5; the deep link is the entry and no navigation, interstitial or acknowledgement stood between the sign-in and the Setup module

not attempted in this run: no deliberately wrong value was submitted, so correction in place, the error render and the message were not observed; the score is the neutral midpoint the arithmetic requires and asserts nothing about the surface

the press on Đăng nhập returned in 56ms and the address changed to the Setup route 317ms later, with no frame captured in between, so the 100ms pressed treatment and the pending signal on the initiator were not observed; the score is the neutral midpoint the arithmetic requires

the destination was the entry itself, zero navigation levels on a console; on arrival the address (/agentos/workspaces/8c8b0002…/modules/8c8b0003…/setup), the selected AgentOS destination in the sidebar, the breadcrumb Module, the heading and the selected Thiết lập tab agree on where the person is; the labels read as the person's words (Tổng quan, Ứng dụng, AgentOS, Ví)

both states the run reached offer a next action: the sign-in form its Google shortcut, forgot-password and sign-up actions; the Setup module five section tabs, three setup tabs, the Rà soát điều kiện action, the message box (Gửi disabled until text) and the sidebar; no state's only exit was the browser's

Case 3 observed by the run's own entry: the mid-flow Setup address opened in a fresh session was carried through sign-in and resumed at that step, which is the repair this session made (the 2.0.3 walk landed on /overview here); back, reload and leave-and-return were not exercised

both fields carry persistent visible labels (Email, Mật khẩu) with placeholders as examples, the show-password control sits inside the field and the submit control is a full-width button; keyboard order, Enter submission and the autofill hints were not exercised by this run

at 390x844 the Setup step's primary action, the Gửi control of the setup conversation, sits at y=972.63 of an 844px frame (55.52x40), and Rà soát điều kiện at y=1265.63; both are below the fold with no sticky bar, so the primary action is reachable only after scrolling; the header's Menu control (62.77x44) is the one target in reach

Đăng nhập is the one verb on the sign-in surface and names the heading above it; on the Setup module the conversation's action reads Gửi and the review action Rà soát điều kiện, one verb each, and the two walks rendered the same controls in the same places at both widths

headings are nouns (Thiết lập module, Trò chuyện thiết lập riêng tư, Ngữ cảnh nghiệp vụ) and controls verbs (Gửi, Rà soát điều kiện); statuses carry their meaning (Bản sửa đổi r2 · Đang mở, Ngữ cảnh đang dùng: Chưa áp dụng); no untranslated key or stub; the seeded conversation and fixture names render in English inside the Vietnamese surface (Current setup started, Dedicated Setup QA generic agent), which the seed supplies rather than the product
